boundary: A uses actual packaged App tree/tab/menu pointer input and reads actual CodeMirror document only. Ordinary writer uses fs, CLI writer is separate python3, neither uses task input. PTYs are genuine input-only Python foreground processes: busy means sustained genuine output, not model computation. No-current-terminal is project file workspace; no handoff records are created. For reactivate/refresh, delay only original own files:watch delivery to prove direct reads without notifications, then deliver unchanged originals. Stale success/open/error gates delay originals unchanged; actual chmod000 causes PERMISSION, physical replacement creates new inode. No model, clipboard, Store/editor injection, custom App success/error packets or daily paths.
